449:t_3:42.en:
$$アスカ$$
「...That airheadedness is your true form.」

449:t_3:43.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's going too far, $$アスカ$$!」

449:t_3:44.en:
$$チコ$$
「It's fine, $$カレン$$. She's absolutely right.」

449:t_3:45.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Then what about that $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$...?」

449:t_3:46.en:
$$ノノ$$
「That just sort of came up from the back of my mind too. I don't really know what it means...」

449:t_3:48.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「The $$地球帝国宇宙軍$$... Isn't that the military from your world, $$ノリコ$$?」

449:t_3:49.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「Yes... That's why I thought there might be a connection...」

449:t_3:50.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「But $$バスターマシン７号$$ is completely different from my $$ガンバスター$$ too. I guess they're unrelated after all.」

449:t_3:51.en:
$$ニコラ$$
「It seems our world and yours are relatively close among the parallel worlds, $$ノリコ$$.」

449:t_3:52.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Anyway! $$ノノ$$ tried to obtain a $$バスターマシン$$, and instead, splendidly became one herself!」

449:t_3:54.en:
$$アルト$$
「I guess there's no point even questioning it...」

449:t_3:55.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Now $$ノノ$$ is one step closer to $$ノノリリ$$! Look forward to $$ノノ$$'s exploits from here on!」

449:t_3:56.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll admit it's an incredible power, but...」

449:t_3:57.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「And here I thought we'd finally learn the $$宇宙怪獣$$' secrets...」

449:t_3:58.en:
$$チコ$$
「We were wasting our time expecting anything from $$ノノ$$.」

449:t_3:59.en:
$$宗介$$
「Everyone, dismissed. We are moving on to our next mission.」

449:t_3:60.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Please wait! I've learned a little about the $$バスター軍団$$!」

449:t_3:62.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You mean the $$太陽系限定種$$?」

449:t_3:63.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Yes. I'm sure they were... looking for $$ノノ$$.」

449:t_3:64.en:
$$ノノ$$
「And I think some misunderstandings along the way caused them to fight.」

449:t_3:66.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I can't explain it well, but I think the $$バスター軍団$$'s true enemies are $$宇宙怪獣$$.」

449:t_3:67.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I don't know whether that means the $$宇宙怪獣$$ from $$ノリコ$$'s world, but their enemies are $$宇宙怪獣$$, in any case.」

449:t_3:68.en:
$$ラルク$$
「So we mistook the $$宇宙怪獣$$' enemies for $$宇宙怪獣$$?」

449:t_3:69.en:
$$チコ$$
「We couldn't help it. That $$バスター軍団$$ really did attack humanity, after all.」

449:t_3:70.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「So they mistook humanity for $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

449:t_3:71.en:
$$甲児$$
「...That's a little hard to believe.」

449:t_3:72.en:
$$ノノ$$
「But it's all right now. $$ノノ$$ made sure to tell them all who the true enemy is.」

449:t_3:76.en:
$$チコ$$
「Well, it's you saying it... I don't think everyone's quite convinced.」

449:t_3:78.en:
$$ラルク$$
「But it is true that $$ノノ$$ and that $$バスター軍団$$ saved me.」

449:t_3:80.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Just hearing you say that makes $$ノノ$$ completely happy, Big Sis!」

449:t_3:81.en:
$$勝平$$
「This is no time to get all warm and fuzzy! That $$堕天翅$$ $$ミカゲ$$ is closing in on $$蒼の地球$$!」

449:t_3:82.en:
$$宗介$$
「That's right. We will be deploying again immediately.」

449:t_3:83.en:
$n
「I'm counting on you, $$ノノ$$. Show us your power as a $$バスターマシン$$.」

449:t_3:86.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'm afraid so... $$ノノ$$ doesn't really know how to become $$バスターマシン７号$$ either.」

449:t_3:88.en:
$$アルト$$
「At this point, I'm too stunned to say anything...」

449:t_3:91.en:
$$赤木$$
「Basically, your determination was the key to reviving $$バスターマシン７号$$. So what matters is your fighting spirit.」

449:t_3:93.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「That's right, $$ノノ$$! Let's fight with hard work, guts, and fighting spirit!」

449:t_3:94.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hearing that gives me a hundred times the courage!」

449:t_3:95.en:
$$ノノ$$
「I'll deploy in $$ＥＶＯ－４$$ as usual, but I think I can become $$バスターマシン７号$$ once I get fired up.」

449:t_3:96.en:
$n
「I'll be counting on you, then. For now.」

449:t_3:97.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Hey, $n! You transform $$ジェニオン$$ into $$ジェミニオン・レイ$$ with fighting spirit too, and you still say that!?」

449:t_3:98.en:
$n
「Now that you mention it, you're right...」

449:t_3:99.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're a hard work, guts, and fighting spirit kind of guy too, $n.」

449:t_3:101.en:
$$アルト$$
「You've finally stopped being the quiet type, just like you wanted. You should be happier.」

449:t_3:103.en:
$$ノノ$$
「Your smile's stiff! You'll never make it through the coming battles like that!」

449:t_3:104.en:
$$ラルク$$
「All right, I get it. Let's go, $$ノノ$$. The enemy won't wait for us.」

449:t_3:106.en:
$$ラルク$$
(Now $$ノノ$$ won't disappear from my side anymore... We can keep fighting together forever...)

449:t_10:6.en:
$$ラルク$$
「How can I leave you alone when you look like that? Tell me.」

449:t_10:7.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「...When $$ノノ$$ and I fought as a team, it reminded me of Big Sis...」

449:t_10:8.en:
$$ラルク$$
「The person who piloted $$ガンバスター$$ with you...」

449:t_10:9.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「It's faded, but this is a picture of Big Sis.」

449:t_10:12.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「She's not just beautiful. She's kind, strong, and dignified... I'll always look up to her.」

449:t_10:15.en:
$$ラルク$$
「I was thinking... We both get called Big Sis, but she's so different from me...」

449:t_10:16.en:
$$ノリコ$$
「You're a wonderful Big Sis to $$ノノ$$, $$ラルク$$. She was able to fight today because you were there.」
